name: preflight-absent-path-prose
title: The documentation path-reference check cannot express a deliberately absent path
description: The documentation path-reference check fails a PRD/spec that names a nonexistent path in a Markdown link or a code span — the only two reference kinds it extracts — with no per-file or per-line way to mark an intentional absence. The only escape is the repo-global optionalReferencePaths list, which would also mask genuine rot. design.md/implement.md are already excluded on the premise that PRDs describe current state; a PRD describing an absent file breaks that premise. main was red on 2026-08-08 from two such false positives, one naming a file the same sentence says is not in this repository, and is green now only because both were stripped of their backticks. This task's own PRD applied the same workaround to itself. Add an inline, reference-scoped [absent: reason] marker and revert both workarounds.
creator: sdelmas
